examples.detail: The candidate describes the closing as an identity/sign-off loop and notes no CTA, but does not preserve the audited opening-to-closing gap: no demonstration and no explicit qualification or guarantee of the breakout-vlog promise.

The candidate says the burned subtitle clearly shows 2026. Audit CC-02/AC-08 finds no visible year in the burned subtitle over 25.408-28.309; only the provided SRT supplies 2020, while the audible year is unresolved.
The candidate reports the fixed-format example approximately as 梁桑. Audit CC-04 resolves the burned subtitle/profile insert as 梁馨和小马; the provided SRT's 良心 is the conflicting form.
All 30 candidate knowledge-unit ranges are within the 135.001-second source and align with the cited segment or declared full-timeline scope; semantic correctness is scored separately.
The audible year should remain unknown because the SRT and visible burned text do not establish a reliable year; the candidate invents a visible 2026 reading.
